hero.subtitle: The Knowledge Resource & Research Hub of BAUST

overview.heading: Welcome to the Knowledge Resource Center
paragraphs: Bangladesh Army University of Science and Technology (BAUST), Saidpur, hosts a modern and resourceful library designed to meet the academic, research, and general learning needs of students, faculty members, and staff. The library acts as the heart of our institution, preserving research results and providing critical access to literature for lesson preparation and academic advancement.
Our catalog is fully integrated with digital databases and houses a vast and diverse physical collection of textbooks, references, monographs, and periodicals.
overview.mission_text: To provide comprehensive information resources, research databases, and modern services in support of the research, teaching, and learning needs of the entire BAUST community, fostering a culture of academic rigor and curiosity.
overview.vision_text: To build a world-class Knowledge Resource Centre and deliver innovative learning services, digital library solutions, and rich collections utilizing the latest 21st-century technological advancements for research and learning communities.

opening_hours.heading: Official Library Operating Hours
opening_hours.description: The library maintains regular operating hours during weekdays and select hours on weekends to maximize student accessibility.

seasonal_schedules.title: Summer Schedule
seasonal_schedules.description: Applicable from 01 March to 14 November. Extended evening hours to support student learning.

seasonal_schedules.title: Winter Schedule
seasonal_schedules.description: Applicable from 15 November to 28 February. Adjusting to winter seasonal daylight hours.

membership.heading: Library Membership Procedure
membership.description: Becoming a member of the BAUST Central Library allows you to borrow physical resources, access digital e-resource kiosks, and utilize the study cubicles.

steps.title: Automatic Registration
steps.description: All students, faculty members, and officers are automatically registered upon admission or onboarding by the library administration.

steps.title: Semester Course Validation
steps.description: Student library membership validity is dynamically extended each semester, dependent upon valid registration of academic courses.

steps.title: University Smart Card ID
steps.description: Smart Cards serve as the official library barcode access key. Borrowing requires verification at the circulation counter.

membership.account_text: You can check your borrowing history, search book availability, and request reservations online through our integrated web catalog.

policies.heading: Library User Policies
policies.description: We maintain a strict academic environment inside the library. Users are requested to read and abide by the following library rules.
rules: All personal bags, coats, jackets, umbrellas, etc. are to be kept in the pigeonhole near the security desk before entry.
Group study, gossiping, loud discussions, eating, drinking, and smoking are strictly prohibited inside the library premises.
Students are requested to handle all library property (fittings, furniture, equipment, books, journals, CDs, PCs) with extreme care.
Mobile phones must be kept on silent/switched off mode. Phone conversations are strictly prohibited inside the reading rooms.
No book shall be issued to students for reading room use or home loan within the last 30 minutes before the daily closing time.

e_resources.heading: Access Electronic & Online Databases
e_resources.description: To support advanced research, graduation projects, and course preparation, BAUST provides high-speed terminal connections to global electronic journals, databases, and library consortia. E-resource access is configured via campus IP addresses, allowing automatic authorization when browsing within the university network.
e_resources.wiley_text: BAUST Library subscribes to **3,500 Wiley online e-books** in perpetual mode (lifetime access) covering life, health, physical sciences, social sciences, and the humanities through the UDL Consortium.
e_resources.consortium_description: Formerly known as the Bangladesh INASP-PERI Consortium (BIPC), these premium scientific research databases are accessible inside the campus IP network.

consortium_resources.name: American Society of Agricultural & Biological Engineers (ASABE)

e_resources.open_access_description: Free, public repository systems recommended for research, reference material, thesis compiling, and general education resources.

collections.heading: Departmental Book Holdings & Catalogs
collections.description: BAUST Central Library holds dedicated sections containing reference text and specialized books mapping exactly to the curricula of all active departments. Detailed physical book registers and computerized databases are organized for:

departments.name: Computer Science and Engineering
departments.description: Comprehensive books on algorithms, software engineering, databases, AI, web development, and networking.

departments.name: Electrical and Electronic Engineering
departments.description: Reference volumes on power systems, telecommunication, signal processing, and electronics engineering.

departments.name: Mechanical Engineering
departments.description: Core textbooks on thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, fluid dynamics, design, and automotive technologies.

departments.name: Industrial and Production Engineering
departments.description: Standard works on operations research, manufacturing processes, supply chain management, and safety protocols.

departments.name: Civil Engineering
departments.description: Essential books covering structural design, geotechnics, environmental engineering, and concrete technology.

departments.name: Business Administration
departments.description: Diverse materials on marketing, organizational behavior, financial accounting, strategic management, and economics.

departments.name: Department of English
departments.description: Classical and modern literature, linguistics, grammar guides, communications, and language development texts.

collections.cta_description: Already have a specific title or author in mind? Access our online library management system to perform direct keyword query search and reservation.
